prompt:
Create a high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE DESIGN MOCKUP, actual webpage edge-to-edge, landscape 1536x1024 composition, no browser frame, not a poster. Russian agricultural drone service brand АГРОДРОН. Use attached drone renders as PRODUCT IDENTITY references only, not layout references: faithfully preserve the actual XAG P150 MAX four-rotor geometry, white saddle tank, black long arms and landing legs, red narrow nose, light silver upper battery and long angular black handles. Do not design another drone. Palette white #ffffff, graphite #202423, terracotta #d34425, neutral #f3f4f0, dark greenish graphite #242c28. Clean Golos Text-like Cyrillic sans, not serif, legible correct Russian. Header brand АГРОДРОН, nav Услуги / Техника / Порядок работы / Контакты, understated action Запросить расчёт. Hero headline exact "Обработка полей агродронами"; supporting sentence "Опрыскивание, внесение удобрений и посев с XAG P150 MAX." Main CTA exact "Запросить расчёт". Include a lower services preview heading "Работы на вашем участке", labels "Опрыскивание", "Удобрения и посев". Photo imagery is illustrative field photography, not claimed customer proof. No invented statistics, prices, testimonials, partner logos, slogans, badges, gradients, glow, decorative HUD, cluttered card grids, excessive rounding or floating UI chips. Generous but purposeful space, polished usable buttons, credible real service website. The hero 3D shown is static representation of future interactive GLB, not a screenshot of Blender.
OPTION A — light product-led composition. Slim white header at top. Hero around 700px tall, near-white single continuous open canvas. Headline in a narrow left column occupying 32% width, large dark clean 64px letters broken into three balanced lines with body and red rectangular 5px-radius CTA below. Our drone dominates right 65% width at three-quarter perspective fully visible, realistic studio shadow without pedestal, no framing box. Product name XAG P150 MAX as small simple caption near lower right, never overlapping rotor. At bottom introduce a compact service preview on white: small left section heading and two horizontal real-field photo tiles side by side with simple captions and no card chrome. The 3D drone is the focal point, avoid giant allcaps background typography.
